scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.js'))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});}}walk('src');walk('bin');console.log('JavaScript syntax check passed')"
